counterfactual_missing_items: No raw span explicitly documents orbital extension such as proptosis, vision loss, or ophthalmoplegia.
No raw span explicitly documents cerebral involvement such as altered mental status or brain imaging changes.
No ABG or ketone/acidosis data are supplied to substantiate DKA.
decisive_items: Haematoxylin and eosin staining showed presence of large amount of fungal hyphae and spores
Black eschar on the nasal root
Detected 22 sequence reads of Rhizopus microsporum
response.rationale: C1 is the most syndrome-complete label carried by the same raw evidence of nasal/eschar necrosis, pansinusitis, fungal hyphae/spores, and Rhizopus/Mucor mNGS. R6 is the same underlying diagnosis but less specific. R5 and R2 do not account for the new focal nasal/facial necrotic process or fungal detection. The low margin reflects strong correlation between C1 and R6 and lack of explicit raw orbital/cerebral findings.

rejected.why: Uncontrolled diabetes and hyperglycemia are predisposing factors but do not explain black eschar, pansinusitis, hyphae/spores, or Rhizopus/Mucor detection; no ketosis/ABG evidence is supplied.
COVID-19 is temporally prior to the key Jan 11 nasofacial necrotic symptoms and does not explain the black eschar, fungal histology, or sinus involvement.
